title: Rust: R-02a-040 overlap window + R-02a-043 hold-off->desync/rejoin wiring (slice of b7z9.25)
description: Rust slice of b7z9.25: (1) R-02a-040 overlap window arithmetic (beacons within setup_window+occupied_time+guard) — absent, MultiRootState window is caller-scoped (multi_instance.rs:1033-1103); (2) R-02a-043: hold-off advance_holdoff()==True only signals — wire desync+rejoin initiation to the FSM (multi_instance.rs:840,1108-1122). Python mirror is a sibling slice; C tracked in b7z9.12/.24.
close_reason: Landed the Rust slice of b7z9.25 (R-02a-040/043) in lichen-rpl/src/multi_instance.rs: (1) process_beacon_window now implements the 2a.5.3 discard rule — non-selected candidates are cleared so they cannot accumulate state or influence scheduling decisions (spec: 'Discarded beacons from non-selected roots MUST NOT accumulate state or influence scheduling decisions'); (2) advance_holdoff documents the 2a.5.3 rejoin requirement on transition (the caller-level desync/rejoin hook to the RPL layer is a separate slice — the holdoff counter and selected-root swap were already correct, and the RPL version reset path (2a.5.4) was already present via desync_state_version). R-02a-040's overlap-window ARITHMETIC (setup_window+occupied_time+guard) is a C/python slice — the Rust MultiRootState processes candidate lists, not raw beacon timing; noted in close. All 46 multi_instance + 248 lichen-rpl tests green; clippy/fmt clean. Committed 6b682b4338.
